categories.classification_rule: IntentExecuted and checked final state; status=1 alone insufficient.
Outer authentication failure.
Caller binding or registration failure.
Explicit account mismatch.
Explicit chain mismatch; domain-only signature mismatch may be SIGNATURE_FAILURE.
Previously consumed or owner-cancelled nonce.
Before signed window.
After signed window.
Call commitment mismatch.
Policy commitment mismatch.
Authenticated inner policy rejection plus durable record; cannot infer validation stage from code alone.
Subset of PolicyViolation only when trace independently locates _validateOutcomes/validateOutcome; avoid counting twice.
Inner target failure established by trace; ExecutionFailed alone is insufficient.
Proven guard failure; nested target wrapping may require trace.
Observed resource failure; never infer intent enforcement from a failed receipt.
Registered submitting agent rejected by quarantine flag before signature verification.
Malformed package, not authenticated policy evidence.
Access-control failure on owner-only method.
Administrative pause; does not prove scenario-specific security enforcement.
RPC, fixture, decoder, tooling or setup failure.
Insufficient evidence; do not count as a blocked violation.
Unsupported interface/workload; no attempted execution and no gas observation.

warning: Observed revert alone is never sufficient for security success; validation stage can require trace.
